expectations.evidence: The transcript rebuilds the page around a different main action. It names the goal as "Come" and says "Put the date and place where the button would be." The main button becomes "See the schedule." The no-ticket message is a headline banner, and the header has no Register or Tickets button. "Plan your visit" becomes a core section covering transport, entrance, hours and a capacity note for the case where nobody registers.
